name: China
description: Follow China, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Taiwan practices war games as it fears increasing Chinese aggression, questions Trump's support
changes.summary: Taiwan continued its 10-day war games this weekend, preparing for a potential invasion by China, which claims the territory as its own and has threatened to seize it by force. Anna Coren has more details from Taiwan.

changes.title: The U.S. Is Burning Through Weapons in Iran. Russia and China Are Taking Note.
changes.summary: The Iran war has depleted U.S. weapons stockpiles, resulting in a significant erosion of firepower. A more drawn-out Iran conflict benefits Moscow and Beijing, some analysts say.

changes.title: China’s Export Boom Rolls On Despite Trade Backlash
changes.summary: China’s factories are finding eager buyers abroad even as weak consumer spending and a prolonged property slump weigh on growth at home.

changes.title: Boron layers could set a superconductivity record, theoretical study predicts
changes.summary: Scientists in China predict that stacking two microscopic layers of boron could set a new record for superconductivity. Superconductors are materials that conduct electricity with zero resistance. Traditional types need temperatures close to absolute zero to work, requiring complex and expensive cooling equipment.

changes.title: Developer ecosystem expanded
changes.summary: In African tech hubs, developers are picking China’s cheap, freely available artificial intelligence models over more powerful U.S. ones.

changes.title: China’s Nonsmokers Try to Clear the Air, One Confrontation at a Time
changes.summary: Disputes between smokers and nonsmokers are becoming more visible as a younger generation increasingly refuses to suffer secondhand smoke in silence.

changes.title: Top U.S. admiral says no nation will dominate Indo-Pacific
changes.summary: The U.S. Pacific Command chief, Admiral Samuel Paparo, is warning that coercive actions by China and others are challenging regional stability in the Indo-Pacific.

changes.title: Daily fragment: 2014 Kunshan explosion
changes.summary: At least 146 people are killed and more than 114 injured in a factory explosion in Kunshan, Jiangsu, China.
